searches_tried: Local comps.py (work and pipeline) for 'huon pine slab' and 'huon pine'; direct Gowans API search for 'slab of huon pine' and 'huon pine' (pages 1-2), about 250 sold SLAB OF HUON PINE lots Sep 2025 to Oct 2026. Gowans hammers: median about $60, most $35-95, 10 percent above $100, top $155-220 (multi-slab or wide figured). Stained narrow single slab most likely $35-70 hammer, upside $100 if figure shows. WebSearch not used (generic sawn timber, Gowans own results settle it). eBay not needed.
viewing_check: Confirm it is Huon pine (smell, pale yellow, pin flecks), measure length and width, check thickness and that the staining is surface only, and look for rot or borer at the bark edge and base.
